text.en: Clients consistently praise Ken and Yvonne for treating visiting dogs as cherished family members. Reviewers highlight their compassionate, patient nature and willingness to go above and beyond, including assisting with pick-ups when needed. Pet parents express immense peace of mind knowing their companions are in caring, reliable hands.

Dog owners report that their pets adore staying at the facility, showing genuine excitement whenever arriving for daycare or extended boarding. Reviewers describe dogs returning home happy, relaxed, and free of stress. Clients appreciate the regular pack walks, outdoor adventures, and playtime that keep dogs thoroughly stimulated.

Pet parents observe tangible behavioral benefits after dogs join regular pack walks and boarding stays. Reviewers note that puppies and active dogs return home calmer, better exercised, and more confident around other companions. Long-term clients credit the structured daily routine with helping young dogs thrive during formative years.

q.en: Where do dogs stay during overnight boarding?

a.en: Dogs stay directly inside Ken and Yvonne's family home, enjoying a comfortable, domestic environment without kennel cages.

q.en: Do owners receive photos and updates while away?

a.en: Yes, clients frequently mention enjoying daily pictures and Facebook posts that showcase the dogs on outdoor outings.

q.en: What outdoor activities are provided for boarded dogs?

a.en: Dogs participate in structured daily group pack walks, park visits, and supervised play sessions tailored to canine energy levels.

q.en: Can the hosts assist with pet transportation?

a.en: Reviewers note that Ken and Yvonne occasionally help with drop-off and collection when owners lack vehicle access.
